editorial:
Set in 1990s Miami, this wild crime comedy follows Daniel Lugo, a gym manager who thinks he deserves a bigger life. He ropes in two fellow bodybuilders, Paul and Adrian, and they decide to kidnap wealthy Victor Kershaw and force him to sign over his money. The plan is messy from the start, and the movie leans into that chaos with loud humor, bright colors, and over-the-top action. You get a strange mix of gym culture, greed, and bad decisions, all pushed to the edge. It is not a subtle movie, but it keeps moving and never lets you get bored.

The cast sells the madness, especially the physical comedy and desperate energy of the main trio. The action scenes are big and flashy, while the pacing stays fast enough to carry you through the darker turns. Some jokes miss, and the tone can feel uneven when real violence shows up. Still, if you enjoy dark comedy and crime stories based on true events, this is a fun ride. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: Kershaw survives the kidnapping and tries to get help, but police do not believe him at first. The crew keeps spending his money and making more mistakes, which finally draws attention. Their crimes escalate, and the law catches up with them. In the end, the main players face serious prison time, showing that their shortcut to the American dream collapses into punishment. The final scenes underline how greed and ego turned a dumb plan into a disaster.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedy, crime stories, and chaotic true-crime movies.
